description: Current official Flemish OGC API source and complete bounded Antwerp verification.
sourceScope: Flanders GRB administrative cadastral-map objects; permanent OIDN identity, UIDN version metadata and CAPAKEY cadastral association. Graphic depiction corrected to terrain, not a legal survey boundary. Only bounded Antwerp globe entry is enabled; Brussels and Wallonia need separate sources.

identity.note: Official GRB specification section 2.2 states OIDN remains the same for a terrain object. UIDN identifies its version/appearance and changes on update; CAPAKEY associates it with a cadastral parcel. Upstream ADP feature IDs are only pagination evidence.

license.status: commercial and non-commercial reuse permitted free of charge with attribution
license.required_attribution: Bron: Grootschalig Referentie Bestand Vlaanderen, Digitaal Vlaanderen
license.basis: Model License for Free Reuse; GRB WFS catalog indicates access without conditions

verification.forcedSmallPages: Count=20 and count=30 requests timed out; normal pages completed. Sorted WFS requests also timed out and are not used by the runtime.
verification.axisOrder: CRS84 longitude/latitude explicitly used for bbox and output. EPSG:4326 WFS samples are not directly compared because axis order differs.

adapterContract.protocol: OGC API Features, GeoJSON, numeric CQL2 object-ID filter
adapterContract.paging: Validated same-origin and same-collection next links supply only startIndex; offset must equal the raw rows already read. GeoServer omits numberMatched and supplies totalFeatures=unknown; it is never treated as zero. Short terminal pages may omit links; full uncounted pages without continuation fail. Repeated feature IDs and conflicting entity geometry fail.
adapterContract.requests: Rebuilt against the fixed collection, retaining all original query parameters.

freshness.note: Individual VERSDATUM values describe the feature version, not the publication date of the current service.
